jobs.description_text: About Syntax Data Syntax LLC is a financial data and technology company that codifies business models into a relational system we call Affinity Data™. jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Within the System Engineering team, lead the technical coordination needed to adapt Lightspeed’s low Earth orbit constellation and associated ground infrastructure for military Ka-band communications supporting the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project - Polar (ESCP-P) and other defence customers. You will build on established designs, analyses, and test plans, focusing additional analysis where decisions require it. jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all. Team Our data platform team is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected by our fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in AD/ADAS, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers. Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. We believe strongly in automation and testing to ensure delivery of robust and correct systems. We are a distributed team, working in the UK and US. Who are we looking for? jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: Why This Role Exists Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE: Xsolla is an international IT company that offers a number of services for video games. We create solutions for developers that help to integrate payments, attract users, and publish games all over the world. We also provide round-the-clock technical support. We are trusted by such giants as Twitch, Valve, Epic Games, Take2 and many more. As a Business Development Manager at Xsolla you will be responsible for researching, understanding, and selling Xsolla's products and solutions to clients in Global. Your primary functions will be sourcing and building new partnerships with individuals in the video game community and closing deals. Since this role is connected to the company strategy you will be able to influence decisions on a global level and the director role.

jobs.title: Business Operations  Manager, Experiential  Marketing
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Business Operations Manager, Experiential Marketing who is trustworthy, self-driven, organized, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, cross-functional and multicultural environment and is energized by keeping a large, global team running smoothly. You will work directly with the VP of Global Experiential Marketing to run the business operations of the department: finance administration, people administration, planning and reporting. You will take on the operating rhythm of a team that is growing to 24 people across three regions, so the VP's time goes to event strategy, quality control and team performance. This is a business operations role, not an event delivery role. The right person for this role will be a dependable, discreet and proactive operator who can hold many threads at once, prepare the numbers and the paperwork the VP needs to make decisions, chase commitments across regions without becoming a gatekeeper, and handle sensitive people and budget information with care. This role is office-based in our Berlin or London office; depending on the location of the right candidate, remote working in the UK or CEST timezone would be considered. As this is a global role, some out-of-hours working will be required. Occasional travel may be required. Longevity Opportunity Vision — Enjoy the game!

jobs.title: CCA Events & Community Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Baku Events Community Manager who is trustworthy, self-driven, motivated, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team. The ideal candidate is a natural relationship-builder who thrives on turning event moments into lasting community connections across the games industry in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA). This is a regional role: while based in Baku, you will cover the whole CCA region, not only Azerbaijan. You will use your community management, content, and relationship-building skills to grow and nurture Xsolla’s network of partners, developers and clients across the region, working closely with the events team, Social Media Manager, and Marketing colleagues. The right person for this role will be personable, organized, and confident engaging senior industry stakeholders, with a strong instinct for the kind of content and touchpoints that keep a community engaged between events. This role is in-office/on-site in Baku and will require regular regional travel across CCA for events. Longevity Opportunity Vision — Enjoy the game!

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (React)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU You will build high-performance interfaces that power our promotional tools, segmentation dashboards, and real-time operational workflows used by game studios worldwide. This role requires strong technical skills, a product mindset, and a passion for crafting fast, elegant UIs at scale. ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com.

jobs.title: Game Designer (Mid/Senior)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are working on a hardcore medieval sandbox MMORPG built around player-driven gameplay, crafting, resource management, territorial warfare, and complex economic and progression systems.The project features a mature and highly interconnected gameplay ecosystem and is currently undergoing an active transition to a new game engine.We are looking for a Game Designer who will help us improve existing gameplay systems, develop new mechanics, and shape the future of the project. This role requires a strong understanding of complex game systems, player behavior, and the challenges of evolving an established live MMORPG while adapting to new technology.

jobs.title: Junior Developer (AI Engineering)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Junior Developer (AI Engineering) to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) team, a platform that connects game studios and publishers with content creators. The position involves participation in all stages of work on an automated content generation system: from stabilising the existing vertical video pipeline for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels to developing the agentic architecture, launching the virtual AI creator direction and building analytics on the results. Working with the team means applying cutting-edge generative models and agentic tools to a real production product every day, seeing the direct effect of your work in content metrics, and learning from the inside how the games industry, the creator economy and content-driven game promotion work. The developer will work with a live system that has a real audience and measurable results, make technical decisions independently, build expertise in generative AI and take on the role of the project's technical owner as it grows.

You bring curiosity, initiative, and a passion for clean, scalable systems. You collaborate effectively with teammates and cross-functional partners to design, build, and improve our technical stack. You’re hands-on, deeply engaged in the code, and consistently seeking better ways to solve complex engineering challenges.

jobs.title: Middle QA Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Middle QA Engineer who is meticulous, technically sharp, and forward-thinking to join our engineering team. You thrive in fast-paced, agile environments and are passionate about ensuring quality at every stage of the development lifecycle. You are not only confident in manual testing but also eager to integrate AI driven testing tools and workflows to elevate productivity, test coverage, and defect detection. You bring deep expertise in exploratory and structured testing, contribute to team best practices, and are proactive in monitoring production behavior and user experiences. You stay curious about emerging tools and technologies, especially AI, and know how to leverage them effectively without losing sight of the fundamentals. If you’re excited to improve test processes, advocate for quality across teams, and drive innovation in QA through automation and AI, we’d love to hear from you.

The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. jobs.title: Staff Economist, Marketplace Economics
jobs.description_text: Team mission Marketplace Economics is a new team at GetYourGuide, built to answer the questions that determine how our marketplace grows and how it should be designed. How much revenue does the next euro of paid search actually return? Which marketing channels are genuinely incremental, and which are taking credit for demand we already had? What price should a supplier set, what does a change in commission do to supply, demand, and liquidity, and how should our ranking and supplier incentives be structured in the first place? We are a senior team working directly with leadership across Marketing, Pricing, and Supply, among others, and the decisions we inform are among the largest the company makes. On the causal inference side, we draw on tools like experimental design, natural and quasi-experiments, double machine learning, synthetic controls, and more to inform marketing attribution and incrementality, spend allocation, and price elasticity. Our structural work models demand, supply, and the mechanisms connecting them, so we can reason about equilibrium outcomes and simulate counterfactuals we can't run as experiments. Most of our hardest problems in pricing and market design need both. Your mission You'll be a technical lead for pricing and supply and a core contributor to our marketplace measurement work. jobs.description_text: The Role You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame. This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain. What You'll Work On Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in. Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else. Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures. Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate. jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description_text: The Role Doit is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading. These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges. The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted. What You'll Own Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery. Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability. Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience. Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing. Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling. Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners. Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product d

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Evals
jobs.description_text: About the role Evaluation is the core of everything we do. We build from the evals: we define how success will be measured before developing a capability, and use the results to guide training, model selection and deployment. We already have hundreds of evaluations spanning domain knowledge, commerce and gaming, with plans to expand their coverage, depth and scale. This work builds on ProLLM, the public benchmarking platform we ran for real-world use cases until our coding assistant benchmarks became saturated. Since then it has been a private benchmarking platform for Prosus companies. We plan to open it again to publish our commerce benchmarks, covering both agentic and decision-making tasks. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own the development of these evaluations and the platform that runs them. The work involves defining meaningful tasks, curating evaluation data, implementing reliable scoring, investigating model behaviour and making results useful for research and product decisions. In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work directly with applied scientists, training engineers and domain experts. You’ll help teams contribute evaluations and build the infrastructure and automation needed to run them throughout model development. In the first three months, we expect you to take technical ownership of part of the evaluation platform, deliver a set of new or improved evaluations with curated data and calibrated difficulty, and work with sci

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Scientist, Commerce Foundation Models
jobs.description_text: About the role We’re looking for experienced applied scientists in two tracks: pre-training, and post-training and continual learning. Each scientist will own a focused research direction within a track. The areas below describe the team’s research agenda; we are looking for depth in one or more of them. The role involves designing experiments, writing the code to run them, analysing results and developing training methods that other teams can use. Scientists own the research questions, training objectives and evidence needed to decide whether a change works, and work with ML engineers to turn successful experiments into reliable training runs. We are a team of around 30 engineers with a flat structure, working directly with portfolio companies to define problems, evaluate models and bring successful work into production. In the first three months, the expectation is to establish strong baselines in a chosen research area, develop and evaluate an improvement, and work with the relevant teams to test it in a downstream application. Track 1: Pre-training This track focuses on continued pre-training of open-weight models on commerce data, including how we represent that data, allocate training compute and transfer capabilities to smaller models. Research areas include: Studying scaling behaviour, data mixtures and compute allocation to decide what goes into the next training run. Developing mid-training methods, including data refinement, annealing schedules, context extension a

jobs.title: Principal Applied AI Scientist, Commerce Foundation Models
jobs.description_text: About the role We’re looking for an experienced applied scientist to help set LCM’s research direction and work directly on its most demanding scientific problems. This is a hands-on individual contributor role in a flat team of around 30 engineers, with no direct reports. You will mentor colleagues and contribute to hiring, but you will not manage people. We define how a capability will be evaluated before developing it, and use that evidence to guide training and deployment decisions. You will help decide which research questions deserve investment, design and run experiments, and develop training methods that can be used across applications. The role requires deep expertise in a core area of model training and the judgment to connect that work with decisions about data, evaluation and deployment. Scientists and engineers work together from the first experiment through to production evaluation, and you will take scientific responsibility for agreed research projects. A central research goal is to learn from a continuous stream of billions of user sessions across the portfolio and turn useful signals into regular updates to model weights. What the role involves Develop the research agenda with the team, identifying questions that affect model quality, training efficiency or downstream results. Use experiments to decide which approaches warrant larger training runs and which should be revised or stopped. Lead selected research projects through implementation, training and eva

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Training Data Platform
jobs.description_text: About the role We’re looking for a senior data engineer to build and operate LCM’s training-data platform, covering acquisition, processing, synthetic generation, quality evaluation and dataset versioning. Our core data includes events, sessions, orders, catalogues and feedback, supplemented by external sources and generated examples. In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work with scientists and ML engineers to turn these sources into reproducible datasets and measure how changes to the data affect model performance. You’ll also build tools and agents that automate preparation, task design and quality analysis. In the first three months, we expect you to take ownership of a part of the platform, such as a pipeline, the dataset versioning layer or the quality checks, deliver a reproducible dataset that a research project uses in a training run, and work with scientists to measure how your data changes affect model quality. What the role involves Build acquisition and processing pipelines for portfolio data and relevant public and licensed sources, including connectors and content extraction. Turn commerce records into ordered histories and link behaviour to outcomes without leaking future information. Develop the shared platform for inspecting sources, configuring processing and publishing training datasets. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver. If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you. Your impact You'll be a key player in the Connect domain , one of the fastest-growing channels at Mollie. Your direct contribution ensures we maximize the value of our strategic partnerships, translating product potential into significant revenue growth across Europe. This is a chance to move fast and own the outcome of a critical expansion vector. You will manage a dedicated portfolio of SaaS accounts , responsible for driving their complete lifecycle. jobs.description_text: Maak het verschil als Support Medewerker in IJsselstein Als Support Medewerker zorg jij ervoor dat klanten optimaal gebruik kunnen maken van de software van CARAT. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor keukenwinkels, grote ketens en andere handelspartners. Je beantwoordt vragen, onderzoekt softwareproblemen en zorgt voor passende oplossingen. Veel vragen handel je zelfstandig af. Bij complexere vraagstukken werk je samen met supportcollega's en softwareontwikkelaars in Duitsland. Je houdt overzicht over openstaande verzoeken en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige opvolging. Ondertussen verdiep je je steeds verder in de software en draag je bij aan de verdere groei van CARAT in Nederland. Op termijn krijg je bovendien de mogelijkheid om jouw kennis en expertise te delen met klanten door het verzorgen van trainingen en workshops, als je daar energie van krijgt. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: beantwoorden van klantvragen via telefoon en e-mail; analyseren en oplossen van softwareproblemen binnen de eerste- en tweedelijnssupport; registreren, verwerken en opvolgen van verzoeken in het ticketsysteem; afstemmen van complexere vraagstukken met collega's en softwareontwikkelaars in Duitsland; verder ontwikkelen van jouw kennis van CARAT-software en ERP- en CRM-systemen. Als enthousiaste Support Medewerker kun jij rekenen op: Een afwisselende functie binnen een internationale organisatie waar zelfstandigheid en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan.
